home.hero.subTitle: I want to find
home.aboutUs.title: Our Journey
home.aboutUs.content1: We aim to be a companion for readers, helping every book lover find inspiration in the vast sea of books. Whether you’re seeking heartfelt motivation, delving into historical paths, or yearning for adventures in fictional realms, we hope to guide you to the most suitable book through reviews.
home.aboutUs.content2: Here, we encourage readers to share their ideas, letting every story shine. Whether it’s a note that moves your soul or a plot that makes you laugh out loud, these moments become precious memories of our shared reading journey. We believe books are not merely stacks of words but exchanges of ideas and connections of emotion. Let’s explore together and make reading an indispensable part of life!
home.function.introduction: Discover the core features of our website, helps you easily master every operation and enhance your experience.
home.function.itemContent1: Every book is a voyage. With the book review dashboard, you can clearly see your progress and plans as you navigate the sea of books.
home.function.itemContent2: Each book is an uncharted ocean. Sailors can document their journey by writing logs of what they've seen and experienced.
home.function.itemContent3: Reading is such a journey. The sailors' footprints are preserved on their personal bookshelf, marking every exploration and discovery.
home.function.itemContent4: On their journey of reading and exploration, sailors collect insightful reviews, enriching every voyage with wisdom and inspiration.
home.hero.content: Get all the knowledge and draw your own road map by reading voyages.
home.hero.title: Sail in the sea of books and write the blueprint for reading.
